title: Fubar API Studio response snapshot
description: A recorded response, kept to compare later runs against. Written normalised and redacted, never raw: a token that reaches this file has leaked into whatever the tracked history keeps.

case.description: Which case this was recorded from, or null in the requests format.

environment.description: The scope. Null in _shared.json, which every environment without a file of its own uses. The file says what it is, so nothing has to infer scope from a name a merge may have given it.

headers.description: Only the headers the policy asked to keep. Storing all of them makes every snapshot churn on Date and Set-Cookie.

body.description: The parsed body when it was JSON, so the committed file is a readable diff rather than one escaped string.

bodyText.description: The body as text, when it was not JSON.
